verdicts.reason: A is broken: the title now reads 'MAKEUP TRAVEL', so the words are out of order. A large translucent grey panel with an empty white bar sits in the middle, and 'KIT' has lost its white bar and drifted to the bottom-left over a busy photo. B keeps the original centred three-bar stack in the right reading order, but the text and bars are small for the canvas, leaving them weak against the busy background. There is also an odd lighter band along the bottom edge, so it needs polish before it ships.
